Former Chief Of Army Staff, Gen. Ihejirika Joins APC (Photos)
item.description: Few months after meeting with Abia-North Senator and Chief Whip of the Nigerian Senate Senator Orji Uzor Kalu the former Chief of Army Staff Lieutenant-General Azubuike Ihejirika today joined the All Progressive's Congress (APC), ABN TV reports.General Ihejirika who served at the helm of the service from 2010-2014 under former President Goodluck Jonathan, made his declaration to join the APC at Isuikwuato country home in Abia-North Senatorial district.

item.title: Court Remands Rivers Varsity Worker For Abducting, Sexually Abusing 16-Year-Old Girl
